attempts.text: {"claims":[{"claim_text":"Democrats support making COVID-19 testing, treatment, and any eventual vaccines free to everyone, regardless of their wealth, insurance coverage, or immigration status.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Tens of millions of Americans have no or inadequate health insurance, which is a crisis.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Affordable Care Act is in place and prevents the current crisis from being worse.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will take immediate action to preserve and expand health insurance coverage.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will provide direct, increased support to states to enroll eligible adults in Medicaid.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The federal government will cover a higher percentage of the Medicaid bill.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will add incentives for states which have not yet expanded Medicaid to do so.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
